name: Native derived pull requires contributing-product config (PBEDP)
what_it_tests: An IsDerived PBE routes through the native DerivedProducts element which requires a PriceBookEntryDerivedPrice config row; a missing row hard-errors 'contributing products are missing' before the formula can price (incomplete rollout backfilled only 199/3453)
proc_mechanism: Native RLM DerivedProducts/DerivedProductsRenewals element maps ContributingProduct<-ContributorProduct via PBEDP config; no row = hard-error; Derived Pricing Filter (ItemIsDerived=true)

test_setup: IsDerived maintenance line without PBEDP config row (e.g. GS-GSE-RNM-EFT8), reprice
